pages.title: Dashboard
pages._note: OpenConnector dashboard shows real-time stats of sources, active jobs, recent call logs and synchronization health — bespoke chart/widget layout that has no equivalent built-in manifest type.

pages.title: Sources
pages._note: Sources list + inline detail panel with connection testing, authentication editor, and call-log preview. Complex sidebar interaction that exceeds the standard index/detail split.

pages.title: Source
pages._note: Source detail is embedded inside the Sources list view via the existing router pattern.

pages.title: Source logs
pages._note: Filterable call-log table scoped to a source; pairs with a log-detail sidebar.

pages.title: Endpoints
pages._note: Endpoints list + inline detail for request/response schema configuration and live testing.

pages.title: Endpoint
pages._note: Endpoint detail is embedded inside the Endpoints list view.

pages.title: Endpoint logs
pages._note: Filterable call-log table scoped to an endpoint.

pages.title: Consumers
pages._note: Consumer list with inline auth/scope editor sidebar.

pages.title: Consumer
pages._note: Consumer detail embedded inside Consumers list.

pages.title: Webhooks
pages._note: Webhook list with event-type selector and delivery-log sidebar.

pages.title: Jobs
pages._note: Scheduled-job list with cron-expression editor and last-run status sidebar.

pages.title: Job logs
pages._note: Filterable job execution log with run-detail sidebar.

pages.title: Mappings
pages._note: Mapping list with a visual drag-and-drop field-translation editor — no built-in manifest type covers this editor surface.

pages.title: Mapping
pages._note: Mapping editor embedded inside the Mappings list view.

pages.title: Rules
pages._note: Rule list with condition/action builder sidebar — bespoke logical expression builder.

pages.title: Rule
pages._note: Rule detail embedded inside Rules list.

pages.title: Synchronizations
pages._note: Synchronization list with field-mapping config and source/target selection sidebar.

pages.title: Contracts
pages._note: Contracts log scoped to synchronizations — shows accepted/rejected object transfers.

pages.title: Synchronization logs
pages._note: Filterable synchronization run-log with run-detail sidebar.

pages.title: Cloud events
pages._note: CloudEvents list with subscription editor and delivery-log sidebar.

pages.title: Cloud event
pages._note: Cloud event detail embedded inside events list.

pages.title: Cloud event logs
pages._note: Filterable CloudEvent dispatch log.

pages.title: Import
pages._note: Bulk-import wizard for sources/mappings/synchronizations via JSON/YAML upload.

pages.title: Settings
pages._note: App-level settings (caching, log retention, OpenRegister connection).
